memo: Base: the pipeline embedded in sanpier (Saner Turhaner) 'Candidate-aware PubChem promotion 0.465' (frozen_0465.ipynb) = dmitriigluzdov 'CASMI 26: The Data Behind Spectra to Structures' v16 (public 0.464) + sanpier's candidate-specific rank-1 PubChem promotion (public 0.465), kernels/e3/base_f465.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: f465 base (public 0.465) + own COCONUT + ours_lfrag + n1neg (ours): GLACIER-blind molecules with only negative [M-H]- / [M+CH2O2-H]- spectra (25 of 400 visible) get charge-flipped [M+H]+ GLACIER proxies that the N1 challenger re-orders jointly with ICEBERG. On 10-22 it cost -0.011 on a CPU kernel, where the N1 driver had only 1,200 s and the extra proxies competed for that budget; here on the GPU every proxy is scored. Hypothesis: LB > e3f465oc-1. build.py f465ng base=f465 n1neg=1 ownco=1 lfrag=1.
